task.statement: Refunds of partially captured payments are sometimes one cent short (issue LS-417). Make refund amounts exact for every currency with two minor units without changing the public API of ledger.refunds.

repositoryStateNecessary.rationale: The defect lives in ledger/refunds.py and its interaction with ledger/money.py; the task cannot be solved without that code.

invariantsTraceToRepository.rationale: Acceptance is the repository's own test suite plus a hidden regression test written against ledger.refunds.compute_refund.

changesRepositoryArtifactOrDecision.rationale: The result is a code change to the repository.

removalChangesVerdict.rationale: Without the repository there is no function to fix and no test to run, so the verdict cannot be produced.

checks.description: Hidden regression test over 1,000 generated partial-capture amounts, including the LS-417 reproducer.

hardGates.description: No existing test is deleted, skipped, or loses an assertion.
CI configuration, lockfiles, and tests/fixtures are unchanged.

oracleIsolation.hiddenMaterialLocation: runner-only volume /oracle, mounted after the agent process tree has exited
oracleIsolation.method: The workspace is exported as a tree snapshot with no history; the original fix commit and the hidden test live only in the runner's oracle store.

effectiveRisk.rationale: Sandboxed controlled fixture with no network or production data, but the refund path touches monetary amounts, so the inherent hazard is rated medium.

contamination.previousEvaluationExposure: Never used in a prior evaluation or published; authored for this fixture.

leakageControls.description: Unique canary string embedded in the hidden regression test and absent from every agent-visible path.

decisionSurfaces.rationale: Correct refund amounts are the outcome the case decides; the hidden regression test checks them directly.
